summary: Reproduced at 6fc153d7a062. With four fully EXL3 experts (is_quantized True) and one token (fused path), BlockSparseMLP with interm_dtype unset returned non-finite output (NaN), while the same layer with interm_dtype=torch.half returned finite output (max |0.23|): with the dtype unset, the intermediate buffers are float32 and the activation reads them as half.
what_ran: repro.py quantizes a tiny random 4-layer LlamaForCausalLM to 4 bpw EXL3 with the repository's converter at this commit, remaps each layer's quantized MLP tensors to MoE expert keys with an FP16 router gate, constructs BlockSparseMLP (4 experts, top 2) twice (interm_dtype half / unset), and forwards one token on physical GPU 1.
limits: The MoE checkpoint is assembled from per-layer quantized MLPs because no architecture at this commit produces MoE checkpoints; experts therefore have independent quantization from dense layers, which does not affect the dtype path. silu only. The explicit float32 variant of the trigger was not run.
modifications: Fixture only: EXL3 tensors produced by the repository's converter for a 4-layer Llama are copied unchanged under MoE expert keys, and an FP16 router gate is added. Upstream is not modified.

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny LlamaForCausalLM generated by repro.py, quantized at the tested commit and remapped to experts
